layout.type: header-content-footer with an independently scrollable virtualized directory
layout.description: A centered single-page directory. Global controls and identity sit above collapsible overview and filter panels, followed by sort/view controls, a virtualized grid or list of AITuber profiles, a floating back-to-top action, and legal footer links. Responsive columns change from one to four.
